best_idea: Zero-initialize C before accumulating in i-k-j order to fix the n=1 bug where garbage initial values corrupt results

best_lineage.idea: Switch from i-j-k to i-k-j loop order so that for each k we stream a row of B and accumulate into C's corresponding rows, improving memory access patterns and enabling better compiler auto-vectorization.
